textAlternative.es: Vidente de Obsidiana, maga de rizos cortos con mecha gris, tunica ciruela y negra, esfera oscura y baston de obsidiana.
textAlternative.en: Obsidian Seer, a short-coiled-haired mage with a gray streak, plum and black robes, a dark orb and obsidian staff.

review: Inspected original and prepared image. Adult Black woman with angular proud serious face and short natural coils/gray streak, tall graceful stance. Deep plum/obsidian robe, brass leaf clasp and small dark orb/copper holder distinguish from braided Storm Caller. Complete natural hands, boots and staff, no large glow. Teatro painterly coherence. Integration and actual miniature readability remain to be verified.
